messages:
alex: Quick PR ping — small cleanup + split of the graph sync widget. Mostly style tweaks and moving a couple helpers into ux/graph/. Can someone take a look? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference/pull/4821

mira: @alex thanks — tagging in the afternoon. Any risk to prod here? unit/e2e coverage? :eyes:

alex: No prod-facing behaviour changes. Added two unit tests and a tiny e2e for mount/unmount. CI was green locally.

sam: Pinged the ownership file — who owns ux/graph now? Also please add a changelog line if it's user-visible.

alex: @sam updated OWNERS to include @mira, added changelog. Not user-visible except fixes to unmount race.

jordan: Quick skim — overall looks reasonable. One naming nit: `syncGraph` -> `graphSync` to match the rest of the codebase. Also `helpers/computeEdges` seems generic; consider moving to `shared/utils` instead of `ux/graph` so other components can reuse it.

alex: Good call. I'll rename and move the helper. Will push changes in a follow-up commit. Example rename I used locally:```js
// before
function syncGraph(nodes) { ... }
// after
function graphSync(nodes) { ... }
```

ciara-bot: deploy-bot: preview build for PR #4821 is available at https://deploy-preview.redwood-inference.internal/pull/4821 — status: success ✅

mira: Left two tiny inline nits (naming and a comment). Once those are fixed I can give final approval. 

alex: Fixed both nits and moved helper to shared/utils as suggested. Pushed a force-push with the rename + test updates. PTAL @mira @jordan

mira: Re-checked, tests look clean and the helper move makes sense. Approved :+1:

jordan: LGTM after the rename and test adjustments. One optional: add a short comment in `shared/utils/computeEdges` explaining the complexity tradeoff.

alex: Added comment. Thanks everyone. I'll plan to squash & merge tomorrow morning unless anyone wants me to wait. :slightly_smiling_face:

sam: No objections from me. :shipit:

alex: Merging at 09:00 PT tomorrow if no cancellations. Leaving the thread for async follow-ups.
